title: fix(console): full-height edge drawers have square corners
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYJouTSkPgKWrVKTCPgDDQX)_
Fixes #35411
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWpXbemoAH9WZiykjb

## 维护者速读

- 控制台里从左右两侧整高滑出的抽屉（消息中心、表单抽屉等）四角从圆角变成直角，不再在屏幕边缘露出弧形缺口；记录抽屉是悬浮卡片，显示它自己的圆角；居中弹窗和手机底部面板仍是圆角。
- 属于「控制台核心业务操作体验」专题，按你同意的界面意见修掉贴边抽屉的圆角。
- 出错最坏是某个抽屉或弹窗的圆角和以前不同；只改一条样式，不动数据和流程，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/index.css`: the console-wide rule that gives every `role="dialog"` surface a `1.25rem !important` radius now reads `[role="dialog"]:not(.inset-y-0)`. The Sheet's `left` and `right` variants are the ones that carry `inset-y-0` (full height, pinned to three viewport edges), so they render square; centred dialogs, `top` and `bottom` sheets and the vaul bottom drawer keep the rounded corners exactly as before. `role="alertdialog"` was never matched by the rule and is untouched. Width, animation and content are unchanged.
- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx` is **not** edited. The suggested `data-side` marker would be an edit in the Shadcn No-Touch zone (`ui/AGENTS.md` Commandment #7), which needs a declared local patch in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` plus its registry fixture: outside the dispatch's file fence. The variant's own `inset-y-0` class is the same fact (a full-height edge sheet) and needs no edit there.
- The record drawer (`NavigationOverlay` drawer mode) is the exception the card names. Since the floating-card change on `main`, it is a right Sheet whose own classes add `sm:inset-y-2 sm:right-2 sm:rounded-xl sm:border sm:shadow-2xl`. It still carries the variant's `inset-y-0`, because tailwind-merge keeps an unprefixed class beside its `sm:` counterpart. So the rule does not match it, and from `sm` up its own `rounded-xl` applies. On `main` before this PR, the global `1.25rem !important` overrode that class. Below `sm` the drawer is full width and flush with the edges, so it is square like the other edge sheets. No selector change was needed for it, and `recordDrawerStack.tsx` / `navigation-overlay.tsx` are untouched.
- One changeset: `'@object-ui/console': patch`.

### Right/left full-height drawers that render `role="dialog"`

Every one goes through `SheetContent` with `side="right"` / `side="left"` (or the default `right`) and none of the call sites overrides `inset-y-0`, so all are square now: the notification center (`ActivityFeed`), the side form drawer (`ObjectView`), the action-modal sheet (`useActionModal`), the metadata detail drawer, the Studio item tools, draft changes, commit timeline, permission-matrix and resource-edit side panels, access explain, build doctor, dashboard record/drill-down drawers, chart drill-down, flow runs, audit log, AI pending-actions inbox, the AI chat mobile sidebar (`left`) and the mobile app sidebar (`left`).

No full-height edge drawer renders `role="dialog"` without going through Sheet. The hand-rolled `role="dialog"` elements are a floating debug panel, a full-screen confirm overlay in the app-creation wizard, the map's mobile bottom card and the floating chatbot panel; the Studio right slot's overlay mode is an `aside` (no dialog role, already square). None of them changes here.

## Tests

- New pin `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/edgeSheetSquareCorners-35411.test.tsx`: reads the selector of the one `1.25rem` rule from the shipped `index.css` and matches it against the DOM the real `SheetContent` / `DialogContent` render. Left and right sheets are not matched; bottom and top sheets and a centred dialog are. A second describe renders the real `NavigationOverlay` record drawer: the rule does not match it, and it carries its own `sm:rounded-xl`. That radius is asserted on the className it ships, because the test DOM has no compiled Tailwind.
- Reverse verification (fix committed first, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored by its own leg and checked with `git diff HEAD` empty plus a HEAD-blob hash match): restoring the old `[role="dialog"] {` selector turns exactly the two edge-sheet cases and the record-drawer case red.

- Ablation: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 303259ad4309 -> 0839540f24b8; `× a left sheet is not matched`, `× a right sheet is not matched`, `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`; restore: diff empty, hash match.

Ablation of the selector: `× a left sheet is not matched`, `× a right sheet is not matched`, `× is not matched by the global rounding rule`, `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`; restore: diff empty, hash match.

## Acceptance notes

- The record drawer's own radius wins only while it keeps the Sheet variant's `inset-y-0`. If a later edit replaces that class with an unprefixed inset, the `!important` rule matches the drawer again. The second describe in the pin catches that.
- Observations, not measured in a browser and not filed: the floating chatbot's fullscreen mode sets `rounded-none` and the phone layout of the mobile dialog content is `fixed inset-0`; both are `role="dialog"`, so the `!important` radius still rounds those full-viewport surfaces. Radix popovers also render `role="dialog"` and are rounded by the same rule. All of this is unchanged by this PR.
- Before/after screenshots were skipped: booting the console with a backend is expensive in this container, and the pin above is the card's acceptance.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open the console at 1280x800, click the bell; the notification center's computed `border-radius` is `0px`; open any centred dialog and it still reads `20px`; open a record from a list and the floating record drawer reads `12px` (its own `rounded-xl`).
